title: Hollow and Crown Again
author: Theo Vane
blurb: Lior Oyelaran, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
